URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/tankers-exit-hormuz-trump-vance-talk-up-iran-deal-prospects-2026-05-20/
TITLE: Tankers exit Hormuz as Trump, Vance talk up Iran deal prospects
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-20 03:44 (updated 04:00 UTC)
AUTHORS: Florence Tan, Humeyra Pamuk
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY:
- TWO CHINESE TANKERS exited Strait of Hormuz Wednesday carrying ~4 million barrels of crude (per LSEG and Kpler)
- Specific vessels: Yuan Gui Yang, Ocean Lily — Chinese supertankers carrying Iraqi crude
- Brent crude fell to as low as $110.16/barrel before regaining most losses
- Trump: war would be over "very quickly"
- Trump (Tuesday White House): "I was an hour away from making the decision to go today"
- Trump: Iran's "leaders are begging for a deal"
- New US attack "in coming days if no agreement was reached"
- VP Vance: "We're in a pretty good spot here"
- Vance: difficulties negotiating with "fractured Iranian leadership", "It's not sometimes totally clear what the negotiating position of the team is"
- Vance: trying to make own red lines clear
- Vance: prevent nuclear arms race spreading in region

IRAN'S POSITION:
- Ebrahim Azizi (Iranian parliament national security cmte head) on X: Trump pausing attack due to realization any move would mean "facing a decisive military response"
- Iran's latest peace proposal (per Deputy FM Kazem Gharibabadi via IRNA):
  - End hostilities all fronts incl Lebanon
  - US troops exit from areas close to Iran
  - Reparations for destruction from US-Israeli attacks
  - Lifting of sanctions
  - Release of frozen funds
  - End to US marine blockade
- Terms "little changed from Iran's previous offer, which Trump rejected last week as 'garbage'"

PAKISTANI MEDIATION:
- Pakistani source confirmed Islamabad shared Iranian proposal with Washington
- Both sides "keep changing their goalposts"
- "We don't have much time"

US SEIZURE:
- US seized Iran-linked oil tanker SKYWAVE in Indian Ocean overnight Tuesday (WSJ citing 3 US officials)
- Tanker was sanctioned by US in March for role in transporting Iranian oil

ANALYST:
- Toshitaka Tazawa (Fujitomi Securities): "Investors are keen to gauge whether Washington and Tehran can actually find common ground and reach a peace agreement, with the U.S. stance shifting daily"

CONTEXT:
- War nearly 3 months old; ceasefire since early April
- Trump approval rating "plummeted" with congressional elections in November
- Worst-ever disruption to global energy supplies — hundreds of tankers blocked from leaving Gulf
- Iran's clerical leadership "withstood the superpower onslaught with no sign of organised opposition"
- Iran retains stockpile of near-weapons-grade enriched uranium + ability to threaten neighbours
